title: When Calibration Rankings Reverse: Accuracy-Controlled Evaluation for Fair Comparison of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.30814v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Calibration evaluates whether a model confidence aligns with its empirical accuracy. Existing studies often compare the calibration of different large language models using global calibration metrics such as Expected Calibration Error and Brier Score. We begin by showing, both theoretically and empirically, that such comparisons are confounded by differences in model accuracy. For fairer cross-model comparison, we then propose ACE, an accuracy-controlled evaluation framework with three complementary views: Instance-Aligned, Distribution-Aligned, and Candidate-Aligned calibration. Across multiple benchmarks, model families, and confidence elicitation methods, we use ACE to study two practically important comparison axes, small versus large models and thinking versus non-thinking models. translated_title: 当校准排名发生逆转：面向大语言模型公平比较的精度控制评估
translated_abstract: 校准评估衡量的是模型置信度与其经验准确度的一致程度。现有研究通常使用期望校准误差（ECE）和Brier分数等全局校准指标来比较不同大语言模型的校准性能。我们从理论和实证两方面证明，这类比较会受到模型准确度差异的混淆。为实现更公平的跨模型比较，我们提出了ACE——一个精度控制的评估框架，提供三种互补的校准视角：实例对齐、分布对齐和候选对齐校准。在多个基准、模型家族和置信度引导方法上，我们使用ACE研究了两个具有实际意义的比较维度：小模型与大模型、思考型与非思考型模型。我们发现，在原始全局指标下先前报告的许多校准优势在精度控制后大幅减弱，同时也发现（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出精度控制评估框架ACE，通过实例对齐、分布对齐和候选对齐三种校准视角消除模型准确度差异对校准比较的混淆，发现许多先前报告的校准优势在精度控制后大幅减弱甚至逆转。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ACE, an accuracy-controlled evaluation framework with Instance-Aligned, Distribution-Aligned, and Candidate-Aligned calibration views, showing that many previously reported LLM calibration advantages substantially weaken or reverse once accuracy differences are controlled for.
